editorial:
Ever wonder what happens when you mix silly jokes with scary movie tropes? You get this wild ride from Santiago Segura. It feels like a fever dream where the humor is loud and the horror is just there for a laugh. You will find yourself following characters who are out of their depth, dealing with weird situations that keep you guessing. The vibe is very early-career Segura, meaning it is quirky, a bit messy, and doesn't take itself too seriously. It is the kind of flick you put on when you want something light but strange to keep you entertained for a short while.

The acting is over-the-top in the best way possible, and the pacing moves fast enough that you won't get bored. While the special effects are definitely dated, that actually adds to the charm and makes it feel like a lost relic from the nineties. If you love weird indie comedies that lean into the spooky side, you need to see this.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with a big, funny twist that flips the scary mood on its head. After all the tension builds up, you find out that the horror was mostly a misunderstanding or a prank. The characters end up safe, but they are left looking completely ridiculous. It ends on a high note with a final joke that lets you know the whole journey was just for laughs, leaving everything resolved in a silly way.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves oddball comedies and retro horror vibes.
